# visionary_alert_channel (Resource)

A notification channel alerts are sent to: Slack, Discord, Teams, Google Chat, a webhook, email, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Telegram or SMS. Visionary never shows a channel's URL or secret again, so changes made to them outside Terraform are only noticed when one is removed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "visionary_alert_channel" "ops" {
  name = "Ops email"
  kind = "email"
  to   = ["ops@example.com"]

  digest_enabled = true
  digest_weekday = 1 # Monday
  digest_hour    = 9
}

resource "visionary_alert_channel" "slack" {
  name = "#alerts"
  kind = "slack"
  url  = var.slack_webhook_url
}

resource "visionary_alert_channel" "pager" {
  name   = "PagerDuty"
  kind   = "pagerduty"
  secret = var.pagerduty_routing_key
}

variable "slack_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "pagerduty_routing_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) One of slack, discord, teams, google_chat, webhook, email, pagerduty, opsgenie, telegram, sms. Changing it replaces the channel.
- `name` (String) Name, as rules and exports refer to it.

### Optional

- `account_sid` (String) Twilio account SID (sms).
- `chat_id` (String) Telegram chat id or @channel.
- `digest_enabled` (Boolean) Send the weekly digest here (chat, webhook and email channels).
- `digest_hour` (Number) Digest hour, 0 to 23, in the digest time zone.
- `digest_weekday` (Number) Digest day, 0 (Sunday) to 6.
- `from` (String) Twilio sender number (sms).
- `region` (String) Opsgenie region: us or eu.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Webhook signing secret, PagerDuty routing key, Opsgenie API key, Telegram bot token or Twilio auth token.
- `to` (List of String) Email addresses (email) or phone numbers in international form (sms).
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Webhook URL (slack, discord, teams, google_chat, webhook).

### Read-Only

- `has_secret` (Boolean) Whether a secret is stored.
- `id` (String) The id Visionary gave it.
- `url_masked` (String) The URL as Visionary shows it, with its token hidden.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is the number Visionary shows, for example in the API.
terraform import visionary_alert_channel.example 12
```
